name: sig_source_c_sin
description: sig_source_c sin wave, amplitude 0.7, offset 0.1, phase 0.3

float_vs_gnuradio.rationale: GNU Radio's fixed point NCO (32 bit phase, table sine) is accurate to about 1.5e-5 of the amplitude; the float instance computes the exact sine of the same phase word. Measured 0.3 LSB and 102 dB; the bound has margin for the phase word rounding (GNU Radio converts the frequency through float32, which shifts the phase by up to 2e-5 rad over 4096 samples).

fixed_vs_float.rationale: Phase truncated to 10 table bits: error power amp^2 (2 pi / 2^10)^2 / 3 -> 49.0 dB; worst sample amp * 2 pi / 2^10 = 140.8 LSB (amp 0.7) plus 1 LSB of rounding.
Phase rounded to 12 table bits: error power amp^2 (2 pi / 2^12)^2 / 12 -> 67.1 dB; worst sample amp * pi / 2^12 = 17.6 LSB plus 1 LSB of rounding.
Phase rounded to 14 table bits: 79.1 dB; worst sample amp * pi / 2^14 = 4.4 LSB (in Q15 units) plus rounding.
